0022600036.text: The Miami Heat (5-6, 8th in the East, 2nd in the Southeast and 1.5 games back, on a two-game winning streak) host the Cleveland Cavaliers (6-6, 6th in the East, on a one-game winning streak) in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group B game, Miami's 12th of the season. The Heat are 1-3 at home and Cleveland is 2-4 on the road, and the teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2 and have not met yet this season, with Cleveland winning the last meeting 149-128 in Cleveland on March 27, 2026. Miami is without Klay Thompson (ankle) and Pelle Larsson (illness), both listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Cleveland has Sam Merrill out with an elbow injury.
